verdict.rationale: Docs show one install mode explicitly copies skills as plain, editable markdown files that you own outright with no forced updates ("nothing updates behind your back"), which supports full data portability/exit. However, the product also offers an alternative 'managed bundle' mode that is explicitly read-only and subscription-based rather than forkable, which cuts against the 'export and leave' promise for that mode. missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that a user who adopted the managed bundle can cleanly export/detach, and no explicit mention of an export command beyond simply owning copied files.
